facts.fact: The mayor of Libreville said on 3 July 2026 that the city already has its own operational system digitalising municipal revenue and securing collection, developed with the public Treasury; the document names no other local government with such a system.

systems.country_label: système de digitalisation des recettes municipales
systems.owner: Mairie de Libreville, developed in partnership with the Trésor public
systems.tiers: city of Libreville; operational in the town hall's revenue collection

systems.platform: QR code payment platform with partner banks
systems.tiers: national; stated to be distinct from the municipal collection system
